Tiana Fortune specialises in scanners, limpet controllers modifications. They're reached through [[Hera Tani]].<ref name="inara-list" />

== Location ==
* '''System:''' Achenar
* '''Facility:''' Fortune's Loss

== How to Discover This Engineer ==
Referral from Hera Tani.<ref name="wanderer-chain">[https://wanderer-toolbox.com/guides/engineering-unlock/ Engineering Unlock Guide], Wanderer's Toolbox.</ref><ref name="inara-list">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara.</ref>

== How to Receive an Invitation ==
Not yet confirmed.<ref name="wanderer-chain" />

== How to Unlock This Engineer ==
Unlock requirements summary:
* Have [[Hera Tani]] unlocked and build reputation with them to trigger the referral.
* Meet the invitation requirement: not yet confirmed.
* Deliver '''50 units of Decoded Emission Data''' — a data-type material rather than a cargo commodity.

For the complete step-by-step process, see [[Unlocking Tiana Fortune]].

== Engineer Unlock Chain ==
''No verified multi-Engineer chain to display for this Engineer.''

Tiana Fortune is listed as reachable through [[Hera Tani]] alongside [[Broo Tarquin]], but that specific relationship still needs direct verification — see the note on [[Hera Tani]]'s own page.<ref name="wanderer-chain" />
